messages:
tara: onboarding scytale17b (17B) int4 on pool C. seeing sporadic OOMs with multi-turns when batch>2 and prefetch=true.

sam: can you paste the worker trace?

tara: snippet: 
```
2026-03-22T18:03:10Z worker-07 ERR OOM alloc 1.4G for kv_cache
callstack: alloc_chunk -> slab_alloc -> gpu_reserve
ctx: prompt_tokens=3800, batch_size=3, max_new_tokens=900, prefetch=on
```

jules: that pattern smells like small-allocation fragmentation from interleaved KV growth + prefetch buffers. frag metric climbs from 0.28 -> 0.62 during spike.

nish: quick triage steps: reduce batch to 1, set prefetch=false, drop max_new_tokens to 256, and enable kv_evict_delta=0.5 to force earlier evictions. Also set slab_align_pad=256k if we re-enable prefetch later.

tara: applied patch to canary instances (10). payload: {"model":"scytale17b-int4","batch_size":1,"prefetch":false,"max_new_tokens":256,"kv_evict_delta":0.5} 

ops-bot: deploy started job=deploy-7890 mode=canary instances=10

sam: add a deterministic long-context synthetic test (context ~9k tokens) and spike generator with 4 concurrent sessions to stress kv.

tara: running stress tests now. after 18 runs: no OOMs, p95 latency up ~45ms, gpu_mem_frag stable ~0.33.

jules: good. queue A/B eval vs fp16 baseline to measure quality delta for the int4 + lower max_new_tokens. also run targeted Q/A and codegen subsets.

tara: enqueued eval e-1021 (600 samples, multi-turn). early results: small perplexity increase ~1.1%, codegen dropout in 2% of cases (minor).

nish: acceptable tradeoff for burst capacity but implement soft-fallback: if gpu_mem_frag>0.55 or OOM_count>2 in 10m then auto-reduce max_new_tokens to 128 and route to scytale-small or fp16 pool. add alert for that condition.

tara: created runbook + ticket: https://redwood.example/runbooks/scytale17b-onboard and ticket INF-4123 for soft-fallback automation.

sam: rollout plan: 3% -> 10% -> 30% with 20m windows. monitor metrics: mem_frag, p99 latency, OOMs, and eval regression flags.

jules: note: when re-testing prefetch for throughput, enable slab_align_pad=256k and a microbatcher surge_limit to reduce allocation churn. previous model onboarding benefited.

tara: will put prefetch experiment in INF-4124. merging canary settings for now. thanks all. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: deploy finished job=deploy-7890 state=completed canary=healthy

tara: follow-ups: 1) INF-4123 (auto-fallback), 2) INF-4124 (prefetch+slab_align AB), 3) add long-context synthetic check to onboarding checklist.

sam: will own INF-4123. passing to next oncall.

jules: nice triage, closing thread.
